summary: Bonner County, ID 50-foot L-4 pole tower built 1934 in the Kaniksu National Forest and destroyed in 1960. No source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1960 according to all three sites; no source describes what remains at the site today

notes_for_editor: All three sites agree on 1934 and 1960. The Forest Lookouts entry cites Ray Kresek; the other two sites may draw on the same material, so treat them as one line of evidence.
